subject: Invite redirect encoding glitch causes OTP not to generate - Supplify

Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Problem with supplier portal invite redirect - can't complete OTP

Hi Marissa / Ben,

We received the supplier invite earlier today but when our team clicks the activation link it briefly goes to the portal and then immediately redirects to a small error page that reads "invalid request encoding" and no OTP is presented. We tried in Chrome and Safari (macOS 12.6) — same result.

Attached a screenshot of the page and the invite URL (screenshot-redirect.png). Our procurement lead is blocked; PO S-1124 is on hold until we can accept the invite. Can you confirm whether the invite link has to be reissued or if there's a known CDN/edge rule that might be rewriting plus signs or URL-safe base64?

Thanks — appreciate the quick help.

Samira Khan
Head of Finance, Supplify Inc.
samira.khan@supplify.com

Subject: Re: Problem with supplier portal invite redirect - can't complete OTP

Samira — quick thought while Marissa triages: if Supplify uses any email aliasing or forwarding + plus addressing (e.g., finance+payables@supplify.com) the link could be getting rewritten by an intermediate mail gateway which sometimes breaks the relayState portion of our redirect. Workaround we can try right now: I can manually generate a compact invite that uses URL-safe base64 and resend from noreply@redwood-inference.com; that usually avoids a few edge rewrite problems.

If that doesn't work, Ops will need to look at our CDN edge logs to see whether any characters ("+" or space) are being converted.

I'll hold on the manual resend until we get the exact URL from you.

—Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer
(Attachment: none)
From: Redwood Support <support@redwood-inference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@supplify.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2026 13:21:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Problem with supplier portal invite redirect - investigation notes

Hi all,

Thanks for the ticket. Investigation summary: our edge logs show an unusual rewrite from the CDN that converts literal "+" characters in the relayState parameter to spaces when requests come in via a legacy POP route used by one of Supplify's MX hops. That leads to an invalid base64 decode on the portal and the "invalid request encoding" page you saw.

Mitigation options we're implementing now:
- Generate and resend an invite that uses URL-safe base64 ("-" and "_") instead of "+" and "/" — this avoids the rewrite.
- Add a temporary edge rule to treat relayState as opaque (preventing the plus->space rewrite) — this will take ~2 hours to roll out across regions.

We attached sanitized edge logs for the first failed request (redwood-edge-log-20261017.txt). Laura, this is a low-likelihood service change but will impact acceptance for this invite; recommend we manually accept the registration server-side if Supplify needs immediate PO processing.

Action we took: manually resent a URL-safe invite from noreply@redwood-inference.com at 13:18 PDT. If that link fails for you, reply and we'll perform a server-side activation for the account.

Thanks,
Redwood Support Team
support@redwood-inference.com
(Attachment: redwood-edge-log-20261017.txt)

Marissa / Ben / Support team — confirmed, the new invite worked. The activation completed and the OTP was delivered as expected. We were able to upload the W9 and see PO S-1124 in our portal. Attaching the W9 for your records.

We'd appreciate a short note for our procurement team explaining the temporary cause (URL encoding rewrite) so we can close the internal incident.

Thanks again for the fast turnaround.

Samira Khan
